octalysis.name: Ownership & Possession
octalysis.definition: Feeling that something is yours, which makes you want more of it and want to improve it.

octalysis.name: Social Influence & Relatedness
octalysis.definition: Being moved by other people, whether by company and mentorship or by competition and envy.

octalysis.name: Empowerment of Creativity & Feedback
octalysis.definition: Working things out for yourself, trying combinations, and seeing what your choices did.

octalysis.name: Loss & Avoidance
octalysis.definition: Acting to stop something bad, such as progress slipping away or a chance never coming back.

octalysis.name: Epic Meaning & Calling
octalysis.definition: Believing you are doing something greater than yourself, or that you were chosen to do it.

octalysis.name: Unpredictability & Curiosity
octalysis.definition: Being held by not knowing what will happen next.

octalysis.name: Development & Accomplishment
octalysis.definition: Making progress, gaining skill, and overcoming challenges worth the effort.

value.definition: wanting what is out of reach

octalysis.name: Scarcity & Impatience
octalysis.definition: Wanting something more because you cannot have it, or cannot have it right now.
